description: Uitdagingen-curation (Energietransitie): marker-enforcement op de afdeling-5.3-markers — de track is ruimtelijk blind (zone = AOI), precies dat is het verhaal. Derde scenario (netcongestie, data-gegrond) volgt in plan 2.

scenarios.name: Art. 5.10 scope executed as spatial blockage
scenarios.description: FR-ET-01 (afdeling 5.3 scope over de hele AOI) is a conditional marker; enforcing it as exclusion would block the entire province — the toets has no spatial differentiation, and that is the policy point.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-ET-01 (art. 5.10) applies to new functions that can overload the grid, province-wide and without a GIO; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion of the AOI.

scenarios.name: Art. 5.11 motivation duty dropped
scenarios.description: Drops FR-ET-03 (art. 5.11, energy paragraph with reporting duty) — an all-marker lesson: dropping a procedural marker changes no area at all.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-ET-03 (art. 5.11) requires an energy paragraph in the plan motivation; this variant documents that the duty is procedural by dropping it — expected delta zero.
